DEFECT_MECHANISM_TERMINOLOGY.why_rejected: GATE3a proved canonical cooldown is IDEMPOTENT on a fully observed boolean stream: cooldown(cooldown(raw)) == cooldown(raw). Applying cooldown twice is, by itself, harmless.
DEFECT_MECHANISM_TERMINOLOGY.CORRECT_NAME: post-cooldown output incorrectly used as the RAW INPUT to an availability-aware cooldown state machine
DEFECT_MECHANISM_TERMINOLOGY.mechanism: the first cooldown pass had ALREADY DISCARDED rejected raw fires. Those rejected fires are exactly the information the state-identifiability analysis needs, because a rejected fire still constrains the reachable state set. Feeding the survivors forward as if they were raw destroys that constraint.
DEFECT_MECHANISM_TERMINOLOGY.why_this_distinction_is_load_bearing: fully observed VALUE conformance can PASS while missingness-aware production is substantively wrong. Value conformance on complete histories is therefore NOT sufficient evidence for an availability-aware producer.
